notes: three isnads before and around the saying: the second group («قتيبة») carries the saying «قال عبد الله بينا نحن»; the first group is a route to the same Companion
«وقال ابن إسحاق عن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود، عن أبيه» names a different transmitter for the same saying: variant group, not a route
Abdullah is the last link of each group (rule 6); the Prophet is the end
